Goal: Public project catalog API + read-only MCP: GET /api/projects (+ how-to-talk-about-it fields)

## Why
Bilko wants Burrow's social pipelines (X product replies, LinkedIn project spotlights) to promote ONLY projects that are really public on bilko.run/projects, checked live — not against a hand-maintained YAML mirror that drifts (Burrow's copy already disagrees with the site: wrong session-manager URL, missing Escape Velocity and Launch Kit). Today there is no machine-readable source: https://bilko.run/projects is a client-rendered SPA (a plain fetch returns "Loading..."), /api/projects 404s, and the bilko-host MCP is a local stdio publishing tool that reads a local checkout which "can lag behind a publish made from another checkout". Bilko also asked that bilko.run itself say HOW to talk about each project, so the copy is owned by the site, not re-invented in every consumer.

## Proposed plan
1. Add a public, unauthenticated, cacheable route GET /api/projects on the bilko.run server returning exactly the cards an anonymous visitor sees on /projects (registry entries with public: true), built from the same source as src/data/projectsView.ts so the page and the API can never disagree.
2. Response shape (schema_version 1): {schema_version: 1, generated_at: ISO-8601 UTC, projects: [{slug, name, tagline, category, status, url, tags, detail, audience, talking_points}]} — url is the absolute canonical link (https://bilko.run/projects/<slug>/ for static-path, the external URL for external-url kinds); detail = the ENRICH drawer story (fallback tagline); audience = one line 'who it is for' (may be empty); talking_points = optional list of plain factual claims a promoter may state.
3. Add the audience / talking_points fields to the registry (standalone-projects.json or the ENRICH table) for the 8 current public projects, owner-reviewed.
4. Expose the same data as a public read-only MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP, e.g. https://bilko.run/mcp) with two tools: list_projects() and get_project(slug) — same fields as the JSON route, no write tools, no auth secrets.
5. Add tests: API returns only public:true entries, field set matches schema, get_project on a non-public slug returns not-found.
6. Document the contract (route, fields, schema_version bump rule) in docs/host-contract.md.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] curl -sf https://bilko.run/api/projects returns JSON with schema_version 1 and a projects array whose slugs equal the public cards on https://bilko.run/projects (today: git-viewer, outdoor-hours, session-manager, academy, social-signals-trader, bilko-host, escape-velocity, launch-kit).
- [ ] Every entry has non-empty slug, name, tagline, url (absolute https), status; detail/audience/talking_points present (may be empty).
- [ ] No non-public project (e.g. page-roast, sudoku) appears in the API or MCP output.
- [ ] A public MCP endpoint answers list_projects and get_project(slug) with the same data; no write tools are exposed.
- [ ] Contract documented in docs/host-contract.md; tests cover the public filter.

## Out of scope
- Changing which projects are public — that stays the owner's registry flag.
- Any Burrow-side change (Burrow is queuing its own consumer work against this contract).
- Auth, rate limiting beyond normal static caching.

## Details
Symptom: Burrow's X product-reply allow-list (/home/bilko/Projects/burrow/data/pipelines/x_session/promoted-projects.yaml) says in its own header "This is a mirror of the public project cards at https://bilko.run/projects ... update this file by hand". It has drifted: session-manager url is bilko.run/products/session-manager (site: /projects/session-manager/), key mcp-host vs site slug bilko-host, and escape-velocity + launch-kit are missing. Burrow's LinkedIn spotlight reads ~/Projects/Bilko/src/data/standalone-projects.json directly off disk.

Observed 2026-10-11: `curl https://bilko.run/api/projects` -> 404 application/json; fetching https://bilko.run/projects returns only "Loading..." (SPA). bilko-host MCP list_projects returns 28 standalone entries incl. the `public` flag, with note "The authoritative copy lives on origin/main — this local copy can lag".

Expected contract Burrow will code against (please keep these names, or tell Burrow if you change them): GET https://bilko.run/api/projects -> {schema_version:1, generated_at, projects:[{slug,name,tagline,category,status,url,tags,detail,audience,talking_points}]}. Burrow will cache the last good response and fail closed (advertise nothing) if the route is unreachable with no cache — so until this ships, Burrow's X product drops pause.

Likely files: server/index.ts (route registration, next to /api/health at ~line 195), server/routes/ (new projects route), src/data/projectsView.ts (public filter + ENRICH detail), src/data/standalone-projects.json, mcp-host-server/ (if the public MCP lives there) — I couldn't verify the best home for the public MCP from here.

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/Bilko/src/data/projectsView.ts
Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/Bilko/src/data/standalone-projects.json
